8 ارتاض , said of a colt, (K,) and ارتاضت, (S, A,) said of a she-camel, (S,) or of a beast
(دَابَّة), (A,) It became broken, or trained. (S, A, * K, TA.) ―
-b2- [And hence,] ارتاضت القَوَافِى لِلشَّاعِرِ (tropical:) [The rhymes, or verses, became rendered easy by practice to the poet]. (A, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
